verdict.rationale: A data-use and AI-training privacy policy is a fair question for any SaaS product that handles user sessions, so this axis applies to Parsec. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI training, data-use opt-outs, or training exclusions. 'Privacy mode' and peer-to-peer connections that avoid Parsec's infrastructure are adjacent privacy features, not a documented control preventing data use for AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
